description: Search for Mobiscroll examples by query, framework, major version, and component filters. Supports multi-keyword queries — all keywords must match (AND logic). Results are sorted by relevance (title matches rank highest).

components.description: Filter by component. Pass the bare lowercase component IDs as returned by listComponents / getComponentSchema (e.g. "popup", "select", "input", "checkbox", "datepicker", "eventcalendar"). OR logic across the array. For Eventcalendar you may append a view suffix to narrow to that view - "eventcalendar.agenda", "eventcalendar.scheduler", "eventcalendar.timeline", "eventcalendar.calendarview"; bare "eventcalendar" (or "eventcalendar.base") returns all views.

framework.description: Framework to search in. Use "js" for plain JavaScript (@mobiscroll/javascript package).

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20). Applies to every filter combination - component-only, query-only, or both. The response reports "total" (matches before the cap) and "returned"; raise maxResults to fetch more.

query.description: Search query — space-separated keywords, all must match (AND). Searches title, tags, component names, and description.

name: searchExamples
title: Search Mobiscroll Examples
